candidate.blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — medication/vaccine storage and administration safety
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — vaccine storage
candidate.educational_objective: Explain why maintenance of recommended vaccine storage temperatures is essential to preserve potency.

options.A: Temperature requirements apply only during transport from the manufacturer.
options.B: Brief temperature excursions are always harmless because vaccine potency is temperature independent.
options.C: Improper storage can reduce or destroy vaccine potency and lead to an inadequate immune response.
options.D: Expiration dates matter, but storage temperature has no meaningful effect on vaccine potency.

candidate.rationale: CDC states that failure to follow recommended vaccine storage and handling specifications can reduce or destroy potency and can result in inadequate or no immune response. Vaccine quality must be maintained from manufacture through administration. C is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Failure to maintain recommended vaccine storage conditions can reduce or destroy potency and produce an inadequate immune response; recommended temperatures should be maintained until use.
candidate.source_locator: Key Points; General Principles; Storage Temperature
candidate.source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
candidate.stem: Why must vaccines be stored at their recommended temperatures from receipt until administration?
